faqs.a:
The Model Traffic Code is hereby amended by adding section 1213 to Part 12 to read
               as follows:
1213. Parking for certain purposes prohibited.
(1)
The city council hereby finds and declares that the parking of vehicles on streets
                  and other public areas done for the principal purpose of displaying the vehicle for
                  sale is detrimental to public safety in creating a traffic hazard, and that the regulation
                  of commercial activity upon public streets and other public areas is a permissible
                  regulation of the streets and other public areas. The city council also finds and
                  declares that the parking of these vehicles is detrimental to the economic welfare
                  of the community, and that the regulation of such parking upon streets and other public
                  areas is a permissible regulation of the aesthetics of the community.
(2)
No person shall park a vehicle upon a roadway, street, alley, sidewalk, or sidewalk
                  area, in a park or in any publicly owned parking area within the city for the principal
                  purpose of:
(a)
Displaying such vehicle for sale.
(b)
Repairing such vehicle, except repairs necessitated by an emergency.
(3)
Whenever a parked vehicle displays a sign or message indicating that it is being offered
                  for sale, such display shall be prima facie evidence that the vehicle is parked for
                  the principal purpose of being displayed for sale.
(4)
For purposes of this section only, the term "vehicle" shall include any device capable
                  of being moved from place to place upon wheels or tracks, as well as devices capable
                  of being moved on or through water or air, such as boats and airplanes.
(5)
For purposes of this section only, it shall be presumed that the person that parked
                  the vehicle was the registered owner of the vehicle, or that the vehicle was parked
                  with the registered owner's knowledge and permission.
(6)
This section shall not apply on any street or highway designated as a state highway
                  within this municipality.
(
Ord. No. 4384, § 2, 4-15-2013
)
